name: Verte de Nuevo
source:
After the ending of Wani's end 2, Inco realizes that his relationship with Olivia has no future with Olivia throwing that vase of flowers at him being the last straw. Now, the human must try to rebuild his life. However, he never would have imagined that his path would cross with an old acquaintance, a black and white girl he remembers from high school.

[From [url=https://rentry.co/snootmods#standalone-and-fangames]Snoot Game Mods List[/url]]

Based on the short story "Verte de Nuevo" from Wattpad.
translation:
在《我想拥抱那只鳄鱼！》（I Wani Hug that Gator!）结局2落幕之后，奥利维亚朝因科砸去的那只花瓶成了压死骆驼的最后一根稻草，令他意识到两人的感情已毫无未来可言。如今，身为唯一人类的他必须设法重建自己的生活。然而他做梦也没想到，自己的人生轨迹竟会与一位旧识再度交汇——那是他高中记忆里的一位黑白配色少女。

改编自Wattpad上的同名短篇小说《再见你一面》（Verte de Nuevo）。
